1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   // Create starfield background
4:   const stars = [];
5:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
6:     stars.push({
7:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
8:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
9:       r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
10:       opacity: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
11:     });
12:   }
13: 
14:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
15:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
16:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
17:   canvas.width = 800; canvas.height = 600;
18: 
19:   // Audio setup
20:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
21:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
22:   let musicStarted = false;
23: 
24:   // Play a tone of given frequency and duration (ms)
25:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
26:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
27:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
28:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
29:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
32:     oscillator.start();
33:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
34:   }
35: 
36:   function playCollect() { playTone(800, 100); }
37:   function playCrash() { playTone(200, 300); }
38:   function startMusic() {
39:     if (musicStarted) return;
40:     musicStarted = true;
41:     // Simple background melody loop
42:     const notes = [261.6, 329.6, 392.0, 523.3]; // C4, E4, G4, C5
43:     let index = 0;
44:     setInterval(() => {
45:       playTone(notes[index % notes.length], 200);
46:       index++;
47:     }, 400);
48:   }
49: 
50:   const ship = {x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-50, w:20, h:30, speed:4};
51:   const keys = {};
52:   const asteroids = [];
53:   const fuels = [];
54:   let fuel = 100; // percent
55:   let gameOver = false;
56: 
57:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
58:     const radius = 15 + Math.random()*15;
59:     asteroids.push({x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: -radius, r: radius, v: 1+Math.random()*2});
60:   };
61:   const spawnFuel = () => {
62:     const size = 12;
63:     fuels.push({x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: -size, s: size, v: 1.5});
64:   };
65: 
66:   const drawShip = () => {
67:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x - ship.w/2, ship.y, ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y + ship.h);
68:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0');
69:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#050');
70:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
71:     ctx.beginPath();
72:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
73:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w/2, ship.y + ship.h);
74:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y + ship.h);
75:     ctx.closePath();
76:     ctx.fill();
77:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f0';
78:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
79:     ctx.stroke();
80:   };
81: 
82:   const drawAsteroids = () => {
83:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
84:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
85:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
86:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
87:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
88:       ctx.beginPath();
89:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     });
92:   };
93:   const drawStars = () => {
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
95:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
96:     stars.forEach(s=>{
97:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.opacity})`;
98:       ctx.beginPath();
99:       ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
100:       ctx.fill();
101:     });
102:   };
103: 
104:   const drawFuels = () => {
105:     fuels.forEach(f=>{
106:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, f.s*0.2, f.x, f.y, f.s);
107:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
108:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0');
109:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
110:       ctx.beginPath();
111:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.s/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
112:       ctx.fill();
113:     });
114:   };
115: 
116:   const update = () => {
117:     // move ship
118:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x - ship.w/2 > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
119:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w/2 < canvas.width) ship.x += ship.speed;
120:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.y > 0) ship.y -= ship.speed;
121:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && ship.y + ship.h < canvas.height) ship.y += ship.speed;
122: 
123:     // move asteroids
124:     asteroids.forEach(a=> a.y += a.v);
125:     // remove off‑screen
126:     for (let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--) if (asteroids[i].y - asteroids[i].r > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i,1);
127: 
128:     // move fuels
129:     fuels.forEach(f=> f.y += f.v);
130:     for (let i=fuels.length-1;i>=0;i--) if (fuels[i].y - fuels[i].s > canvas.height) fuels.splice(i,1);
131: 
132:     // collisions
133:     const shipRect = {x: ship.x - ship.w/2, y: ship.y, w: ship.w, h: ship.h};
134:     const collides = (ax, ay, ar) => {
135:       // simple circle‑rect collision
136:       const cx = Math.max(shipRect.x, Math.min(ax, shipRect.x + shipRect.w));
137:       const cy = Math.max(shipRect.y, Math.min(ay, shipRect.y + shipRect.h));
138:       const dx = ax - cx, dy = ay - cy;
139:       return dx*dx + dy*dy < ar*ar;
140:     };
141:     for (let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
142:       if (collides(asteroids[i].x, asteroids[i].y, asteroids[i].r)) {playCrash(); gameOver=true; break;}
143:     }
144:     for (let i=fuels.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
145:       const f=fuels[i];
146:       if (collides(f.x, f.y, f.s/2)) {playCollect(); fuel = Math.min(100, fuel+20); fuels.splice(i,1);}    }
147: 
148:     // fuel consumption
149:     fuel -= 0.05;
150:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
151:   };
152: 
153:   const render = () => {
154:     // draw background starfield first
155:     drawStars();
156:     drawShip();
157:     drawAsteroids();
158:     drawFuels();
159:     // fuel bar
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
161:     ctx.fillRect(10,10, fuel*2, 10);
162:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
163:     ctx.strokeRect(10,10,200,10);
164:     if (gameOver) {
165:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
166:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
167:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
168:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
169:     }
170:   };
171: 
172:   let frame = 0;
173:   const loop = () => {
174:     if (!gameOver) {
175:       if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
176:       if (frame % 500 === 0) spawnFuel();
177:       update();
178:     }
179:     render();
180:     frame++;
181:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
182:   };
183: 
184:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
185:     keys[e.key]=true;
186:     startMusic();
187:     // resume audio context if needed (user interaction)
188:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
189:   });
190:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>keys[e.key]=false);
191: 
192:   loop();
193: })();
